rows.ARS:
Red blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: Forty-niner
Exhibition name: Forty-niner
rows.Origin:
Bred by Herbert C. Swim (United States, 1949).
Introduced in United States by Armstrong Roses as 'Forty-niner'.
Introduced in Australia by Hazlewood Bros. Pty. Ltd. in 1950 as 'Forty-niner'.
rows.Bloom: Rose-red to cherry-red, yellow reverse. Mild fragrance. 25 to 40 petals. Average diameter 3.75". Medium-large, full (26-40 petals), open bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Compact, upright. Glossy, dark green, leathery foliage.

Height: up to 4'7" (up to 140cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Vigorous. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
